description: Source code for a command line interface client that communicates with a USP Agent via UNIX domain sockets or executes commands locally, handling command execution, socket communication, and database initialization.

methods.name: CLI_CLIENT_ExecCommand
methods.description: Executes a CLI command either remotely via socket or locally by initializing database and data model, then executing the command.

methods.name: HandleCliCommandRemotely
methods.description: Sends a command to the USP Agent via UNIX domain socket and prints the response.

methods.name: HandleCliCommandLocally
methods.description: Executes a command locally by initializing database and data model, then running the command.
